definitions.gloss: pad of the finger; fingertip pad
definitions.explanation: The soft, rounded underside of a finger between the tip and the first joint.

examples.english: To press with the pad of one's finger.

examples.japanese: {指|ゆび}の{腹|はら}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{優|やさ}しく→優しい：02640_yasashii⟧⟦マッサージ→マッサージ：00272_massaaji⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: To massage gently with the pads of the fingers.

examples.japanese: ⟦スマホ→スマホ：04721_sumaho⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{画面|がめん}→画面：04406_gamen⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧、⟦{爪|つめ}→爪：02159_tsume⟧⟦ではなく→ではなく：09578_dehanaku⟧{指|ゆび}の{腹|はら}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{触|さわ}る→触る：00808_sawaru⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{反応|はんのう}→反応：04812_hannou⟧しやすい。
examples.english: A phone screen responds better when you touch it with the pad of your finger rather than your nail.
